# fct_facebook_marketing_campaign_performance

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_facebook_marketing_campaign_performance` · dbt area: `growth`

Adset-level Paid Social advertising performance from Facebook. Each row represents the combination of a spend date + campaign + adset + country. Sourced from Facebook [Meta] Marketing and a Google Sheets backup (pre 2023-06-06).

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `adset_id` | Unique ID for an adset within a campaign >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `adset_name` | Name of the adset as set in Facebook Ads >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `campaign_id` | Unique ID for a campaign  >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `campaign_name` | Full campaign name as set in Facebook Ads >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `campaign_performance_id` | Surrogate Primary Key assigned to each row using date, campaign_id, adset_id, and country. >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `country_code` | Geographic target country code from country reporting; where unassigned, defaults to country with highest daily spend for that campaign/adset >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `impressions` | Total number of impressions, where an impression is one instance of a piece of advertising content being shown to a user, regardless of whether they interact with it. >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `spend_usd` | Total spend in $ USD for this campaign/adset on this date >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
| `spend_date` | Date of the performance metrics (daily grain) >> SOURCE - Facebook Ads |
